title: populus × canadensis f. aurea
intro: Populus × canadensis f. aurea, commonly known as Golden Poplar or Golden Cottonwood, is a cultivar of the Populus canadensis, a deciduous tree native to North America. This plant is valued for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Golden Poplar include its ability to act as an antiseptic, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic agent, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
